place.name: Eifel
place.description: The Eifel (German: [ˈaɪfl̩] ; Luxembourgish: Äifel, pronounced [ˈæːɪ̯fəl]) is a middle mountain range in western Germany, eastern Belgium, southeastern Netherlands and northern Luxembourg. It occupies parts of southwestern North Rhine-Westphalia, northwestern Rhineland-Palatinate and the southern area of the German-speaking Community of Belgium.
